asset_manifest.pose: dino_bones_paleontologist_4 (adult male, Latino, short brown hair, black aviator glasses, khaki shorts) is crouched on his knees over a slab of iron-rich clay, using an air-bulb blower to remove fine silt from a symmetrical, paired trackway.

visual_notes.ichnology: A highly symmetrical parallel trackway left by a marine turtle. It displays synchronized, paired flipper scrapes (manus) on the left and right sides, accompanied by a continuous, thin, straight central tail-drag line carved deeply into the center.
visual_notes.ground: Variegated reddish-brown mud and iron-oxide red laminated limestone with nearby shallow turquoise pools.
